pr.title: Add Slice ERC-8128 delegation clear-signing descriptor

Delegation(string issuer,string delegate.interpolatedIntent: Allow {delegate} to act on behalf of {issuer} at {audiencePermissions.[].audience}, with permission details not displayed on this screen, from {validAfter} until {validUntil}. Allow up to {remainingDelegations} further levels of delegation. Each request may remain valid for {maxRequestValiditySeconds}. This grant requires single-use requests: {requireNonReplayable}. Additional signed request requirements and any parent authorization still apply.

fields.label: You are allowing
fields.value: The delegate to send requests on your behalf to the listed services within the time limits. Permission details are not displayed on this screen.

fields.label: Permission details
fields.value: This signing screen does not display the permissions granted for each service.
